dct_title_s: General map of part of the North-West Territories including the province of Manitoba shewing Dominion land surveys to 31st December, 1882 / compiled & drawn by J. Johnston.
dct_description_sm: Shows subdivision and outline survey areas, townships and ranges, Indian reserves, mounted police stations, etc.; Relief shown by hachures and spot heights.; At head of title: Dominion of Canada.; Signed by Lindsay Russell, Surveyor General, Dominion Land Office.; Ms. notes in black ink in margins as to revisions and cost of "engraving this map in the best style". Signed: I.I.; Includes index map and references.; On verso, written by hand: Dominion of Canada 1882.
1 map : color 73 x 110 cm, on sheet 85 x 120 cm
